reuse.why: Builds on the existing saveLinkedAccount, assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and handleSyncResponse, registers the provider in SYNC_PROVIDERS, and folds the per-provider link/download copies into linkProviderAccount and downloadProviderTransactions that Fintegra and the existing providers share.

duplication.why: Instead of adding a fifth copy of the link and download boilerplate, it removes the existing copies; per-provider differences (bank key, fileId, sync-event tables) become explicit arguments.

placement.why: Link logic stays in accounts/app.ts, downloads in accounts/sync.ts, the URL in server-config.ts and the provider id in types/models/bank-sync.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: The consolidation of four existing providers' link and download functions goes well beyond adding Fintegra, and it touches two desktop-client files although the request says the client is handled separately (needed only because SYNC_PROVIDERS feeds an exhaustive Record).

maintainability.why: Adding a provider is now a thin wrapper, which is easy to own; the provider parameter is a hand-written literal union instead of BankSyncProviders and processBankSyncDownload gains another provider-specific condition.
